Available during open hours: Tuesday, November 24th & Wednesday, November 25th <\/em><\/p>


<\/p>

Staying in town over the Thanksgiving holidays? Stop by Merry Pin anytime during open hours on November 24th and 25th for our Autumnal Make & Takes<\/strong>. Whether you have 20 minutes or a few hours, we have three cozy fall crafts ready for you to jump in and create at your own pace:<\/p>

  • Wooden Slice Art<\/strong> \u2014 $14 per roundPaint, stain, or design a custom rustic wood round perfect for decor or gift-giving.<\/li>
  • Paper Bugs<\/strong> \u2014 $10 (Unlimited creation!)Craft whimsical, sculpted paper insects using colorful autumn paper, textures, and wire.<\/li>
  • Junk Journaling<\/strong> \u2014 $14 (Unlimited creation!)Layer vintage ephemera, seasonal cutouts, and patterned papers to build your own textured autumn journal pages.<\/li><\/ul>


    <\/p>

    Special Event Perk:<\/strong><\/p>

    Pair your craft with a Discounted Day Pass to the Craft Commons for just $15<\/strong>! Gain full access to our open studio space, specialized tools, and creative community for the entire day.<\/p>

    No advance registration required\u2014just walk in, pay at the counter, and craft away!<\/em><\/p>


    <\/p>

    Note: This is a Make & Take, not a workshop or class. That means there is no facilitator. We will have all of the supplies out for you as well as instructions for you to follow.<\/em><\/strong><\/p>


    <\/p>

    For Ages:<\/strong> 6+<\/p>


    <\/p>

    Important Details\u2014<\/em><\/strong><\/p>


    <\/p>

    • No outside food or drink allowed. We have food and drink available for purchase at our on-site cafe.\u00a0Visit our cafe page to view the menu.<\/a><\/li>
    • For details on parking and accessibility,\u00a0please see our event FAQs<\/a>.<\/li>
    • Refund Policy: Workshops, classes, make & takes, and other event fees are non-refundable. Cancellations must be made at least 7 days beforehand to receive store credit (equal to the amount of your ticket minus $5 for credit card fees). If canceled or rescheduled for any reason, you will receive 100% of your fee as store credit. No refunds will be given for missed one-time classes, events, or workshops, regardless of the reason.\u00a0Why such a strict policy? We have to order supplies far in advance. If it's less than 7 days until the event, we may be unable to find someone to fill your spot.<\/li><\/ul>
